errors.message: invalid release name "My_App": a lowercase RFC 1123 label must consist of lower case alphanumeric characters or '-', and must start and end with an alphanumeric character (e.g. 'my-name',  or '123-abc', regex used for validation is '[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?')
errors.hint: release names are lowercase letters, digits and '-', at most 63 characters, e.g. my-app
